title: Automatic Assistance to Reduce Information Overload during Software Issue Report Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.07109v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern issue tracking systems are used to log an issue and track it from its inception to closure. Issue reports with diverse discussions from stakeholders can be large and verbose, making them challenging to analyze quickly. Our developer interviews revealed that they struggled with the diverse information in issue reports and demanded automated techniques to classify and summarize information. We designed a tool, iSum (issue summarizer), that helps with the automatic classification and summarization of information types discussed in issue reports. The summarizer offers two views: 1. Developer View takes an issue report as input and outputs visualized summaries of information in the report. 2. Manager View takes a suite of all issue reports under a given software project as inputs and shows the prevalence and trends of different information types across the reports. translated_title: 用于减少软件问题报告理解过程中信息过载的自动辅助工具
translated_abstract: 现代问题跟踪系统用于记录问题并跟踪其从产生到关闭的全过程。包含利益相关者多样讨论的问题报告往往篇幅庞大且冗长，使其难以快速分析。我们对开发者的访谈表明，他们在处理问题报告中的多样化信息时面临困难，并期望有自动化技术来分类和总结信息。我们设计了一个名为 iSum（问题摘要器）的工具，可对问题报告中讨论的信息类型进行自动分类和总结。该摘要器提供两种视图：1. 开发者视图：以单个问题报告为输入，输出报告中信息的可视化摘要。2. 经理视图：以给定软件项目下所有问题报告的集合为输入，展示不同信息类型在各报告中的普遍程度和变化趋势。我们通过三项研究对 iSum 进行了评估。1. 在一项针对（原文此处截断）……的实证研究中
tldr: 本文提出了iSum工具，能够自动分类和总结软件问题报告中的信息类型，通过开发者视图为单个报告生成可视化摘要、通过经理视图展示项目内各报告的信息类型普遍程度与趋势，帮助开发者缓解问题报告带来的信息过载。
en_tdlr: This paper presents iSum, a tool that automatically classifies and summarizes information types in software issue reports, offering a Developer View with visualized summaries of individual reports and a Manager View showing the prevalence and trends of information types across a project, thereby reducing developers' information overload.
